scripts.build: vite build && rm -rf docs/assets && cp -r dist/* docs/ && touch docs/.nojekyll
scripts.deploy:gh-pages: npm run build && git worktree add /tmp/gh-pages origin/gh-pages && rm -rf /tmp/gh-pages/* && cp -r dist/* /tmp/gh-pages/ && touch /tmp/gh-pages/.nojekyll && cd /tmp/gh-pages && git add -A && git commit -m 'Deploy to gh-pages' && git push origin HEAD:gh-pages && cd - && git worktree remove /tmp/gh-pages
